title: File:View of Porto Ferrajo from the Sea 1799, after Major James Weir - UK BM 860496001.jpg
description:
Island of Elba with four interesting views of the capital. View of Porto Ferrajo from the Sea

Print after Major James Weir
Republished state. 1799, this state 1814. Colour etching and aquatint with additional hand-colouring.
Additional Makers: Publisher - James Daniell; Print maker - Francis Jukes

Inscription: 'James Weir' to 'the Right Honble Earl Spencer' and 'Drawn by Capt. James Weir. / Engraved by F. Jukes. / London Pub.d by Ja.s Daniell, 480, Strand, 1814
